# Kling Motion Control

> > AI-powered motion transfer and video generation platform featuring Kling 2.6 and 3.0 Motion Control with Element Binding for precise character animation and dance video creation.

Kling Motion Control offers image-to-video AI tools that transfer motion from reference videos to static images, enabling users to create professional character animations, AI dance videos, and 4K cinematic content. The platform features advanced technologies including Element Binding for precise action copying and facial identity preservation.
